coverage.description: All recorded nodes and edges incident to the 6,477 papers represented by 26,410 question/method entries. Structural containment and unvalidated mention edges remain explicitly typed; they are not independent scientific assertions. Exact object relations, numbered extraction-window context and whole-paper context stay separate. Nonpositive and withheld reviews remain inactive assessments.
